title: Architecture team config
description: Schema for <home>/architecture.yaml and <home>/architecture.local.yaml: the decision-record keys /architecture:record-decision reads through the four layers of docs/adr/0075-resolve-plugin-settings-through-one-four-layer-cascade-and-a-bound-convention-home.md. The map-* keys stay in the topic doc <home>/architecture/README.md (plugins/architecture/reference/config.md).

adr_template.description: Repo-relative path to the Markdown template /architecture:record-decision recommends when the repository has no ADR convention. A repository's own convention always wins. Default: the bundled skills/record-decision/templates/adr.md.

adr_extra_triggers.description: Extra conditions that join the ADR admission test's 'at least one' list (for example 'touches personal data'). A real alternative must still have been weighed.
